data.name: Divani
data.gender_notes: Divani is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Divani is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Dhan' which means wealth. This name is associated with the goddess of wealth and prosperity, Lakshmi. Divani signifies abundance, richness, and good fortune in one's life. The name Divani carries the meaning “Goddess of wealth, prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Divani usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of wealth, prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Divani belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of wealth, prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Divani total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Divani holds a significant cultural impact in Hindu society as it is a popular and revered name, often given to females, in India. The name symbolizes the attainment of wealth, prosperity, and success, which are held in high esteem in Indian culture. Divani is believed to bring good fortune, happiness, and contentment to her bearer.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Divani is deeply connected to the Hindu deity Lakshmi, who embodies wealth, prosperity, and abundance. By bearing this name, one is believed to be blessed with her divine grace and protection. The name serves as a constant reminder of the spiritual values of abundance, generosity, and contentment, and inspires its bearer to strive towards these ideals in life.
